{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgN7Bsv32DVcMVhUobYLB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KWgCTCVwRkReMTKfevYPu5","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > cholesky/cholesky.cpp <<'EOF'\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition benchmark.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy\n// ------------------------\n//  * MPI    : the matrix is distributed in a 1-D block-cyclic fashion over\n//             block columns of width NB.  Every rank drives one GPU.  The\n//             factorization is a right-looking blocked algorithm: the owner of\n//             block column k factors its panel on the GPU and broadcasts it,\n//             every rank then applies the rank-NB update to the block columns\n//             it owns.  A one-step lookahead overlaps the panel factorization\n//             and the (non-blocking) panel broadcast of step k+1 with the\n//             trailing update of step k.\n//  * CUDA   : all floating point work (matrix generation, panel factorization,\n//             trailing update, validation) runs on the GPU with custom kernels\n//             (tiled DGEMM/SYRK, triangular solve, small Cholesky tiles).\n//  * OpenMP : host side data movement (transposes, assembling the row-major\n//             result, reductions) is multi-threaded.\n//\n// Semantics are those of the original sequential program: same matrix\n// generation (A = B*B^T + n*I with rand_r seed 42), the same lower triangular\n// factor L (upper part zeroed) and the same validation / output.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Tunables\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr int NB = 256;  // distributed block column width (panel width)\nconstexpr int IB = 32;   // inner block size of the panel factorization\nconstexpr int TM = 64;   // DGEMM tile rows\nconstexpr int TN = 64;   // DGEMM tile cols\nconstexpr int TK = 16;   // DGEMM tile depth\nconstexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                            \\\n    do {                                                                            \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                 \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                 \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,        \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                           \\\n        }                                                                           \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define MPI_CHECK(call)                                                             \\\n    do {                                                                            \\\n        int err__ = (call);                                                         \\\n        if (err__ != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                                 \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d in %s at %s:%d\\n\", err__, #call,          \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__); All matrices are column-major with explicit leading dimension.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// C(M x N) = (accumulate ? C : 0) + alpha * A(M x K) * B(N x K)^T for the\n// TM x TN tile at (row0, col0).  256 threads, each computes a 4 x 4 block.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void gemm_nt_tile(const double* __restrict__ A, int lda,\n                                             const double* __restrict__ B, int ldb,\n                                             double* __restrict__ C, int ldc, int M,\n                                             int N, int K, int row0, int col0,\n                                             double alpha, bool accumulate) {\n    __shared__ double As[TK][TM];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TK][TN];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15;\n    const int ty = tid >> 4;\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = 0.0;\n\n    double ra[4], rb[4];\n\n    auto load_regs = [&](int k0) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n            const int idx = tid + GEMM_THREADS * i;\n            const int r = idx & (TM - 1);\n            const int kk = idx / TM;\n            const int gk = k0 + kk;\n            const int gr = row0 + r;\n            const int gc = col0 + r;\n            ra[i] = (gr < M && gk < K) ? A[(size_t)gk * lda + gr] : 0.0;\n            rb[i] = (gc < N && gk < K) ? B[(size_t)gk * ldb + gc] : 0.0;\n        }\n    };\n    auto store_smem = [&]() {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n            const int idx = tid + GEMM_THREADS * i;\n            const int r = idx & (TM - 1);\n            const int kk = idx / TM;\n            As[kk][r] = ra[i];\n            Bs[kk][r] = rb[i];\n        }\n    };\n\n    load_regs(0);\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += TK) {\n        store_smem();\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (k0 + TK < K) load_regs(k0 + TK);  // prefetch next tile\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < TK; ++kk) {\n            double a[4], b[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n                a[i] = As[kk][tx + 16 * i];\n                b[i] = Bs[kk][ty + 16 * i];\n            }\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n        const int gc = col0 + ty + 16 * j;\n        if (gc >= N) continue;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n            const int gr = row0 + tx + 16 * i;\n            if (gr < M) {\n                const size_t o = (size_t)gc * ldc + gr;\n                const double v = alpha * acc[i][j];\n                C[o] = accumulate ? C[o] + v : v;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ngemm_nt_kernel(const double* __restrict__ A, int lda, const double* __restrict__ B,\n               int ldb, double* __restrict__ C, int ldc, int M, int N, int K,\n               double alpha, int accumulate) {\n    gemm_nt_tile(A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, M, N, K, blockIdx.y * TM, blockIdx.x * TN,\n                 alpha, accumulate != 0);\n}\n\n// Trailing update of all locally owned block columns p = pStart + blockIdx.z\n// with the broadcast panel of step k (packed, rows relative to k*NB, leading\n// dimension rowsK):   A(jb) -= Lpanel(rows >= jb*NB) * Lpanel(rows of jb)^T\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ntrailing_update_kernel(double* __restrict__ panels, const double* __restrict__ dpanel,\n                       int n, int P, int rank, int k, int pStart, int rowsK, int wk) {\n    const int p = pStart + blockIdx.z;\n    const int jb = p * P + rank;\n    const int rowStart = jb * NB;\n    const int M = n - rowStart;\n    if ((int)(blockIdx.y * TM) >= M) return;  // uniform per block\n    const int N = min(NB, n - jb * NB);\n    double* C = panels + (size_t)p * n * NB + rowStart;\n    const double* A = dpanel + (rowStart - k * NB);\n    gemm_nt_tile(A, rowsK, A, rowsK, C, n, M, N, wk, blockIdx.y * TM, blockIdx.x * TN,\n                 -1.0, true);\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of a tw x tw (tw <= IB) diagonal tile, lower part.\n// One warp.  On a non positive-definite pivot the global index is recorded.\n__global__ void potf2_kernel(double* __restrict__ T, int ldt, int tw, int gidx0,\n                             int* __restrict__ flag) {\n    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n    const int t = threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < tw)\n        for (int c = 0; c <= t; ++c) s[t][c] = T[(size_t)c * ldt + t];\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int j = 0; j < tw; ++j) {\n        double d = s[j][j];\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < j; ++kk) d -= s[j][kk] * s[j][kk];\n        if (d <= 0.0) {\n            if (t == 0) atomicMin(flag, gidx0 + j);\n            return;\n        }\n        d = sqrt(d);\n        if (t == j) s[j][j] = d;\n        if (t > j && t < tw) {\n            double v = s[t][j];\n            for (int kk = 0; kk < j; ++kk) v -= s[t][kk] * s[j][kk];\n            s[t][j] = v / d;\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n    }\n    if (t < tw)\n        for (int c = 0; c <= t; ++c) T[(size_t)c * ldt + t] = s[t][c];\n}\n\n// R(M x tw) := R * L^{-T}, L lower triangular tw x tw.  One thread per row.\n__global__ void trsm_rnt_kernel(const double* __restrict__ L, int ldl,\n                                double* __restrict__ R, int ldr, int M, int tw) {\n    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < tw * tw; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx % tw, c = idx / tw;\n        if (c <= r) s[r][c] = L[(size_t)c * ldl + r];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    const int row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (row >= M) return;\n    double x[IB];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < IB; ++j) x[j] = (j < tw) ? R[(size_t)j * ldr + row] : 0.0;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < IB; ++j) {\n        if (j < tw) {\n            double v = x[j];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int kk = 0; kk < j; ++kk) v -= x[kk] * s[j][kk];\n            x[j] = v / s[j][j];\n        }\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < IB; ++j)\n        if (j < tw) R[(size_t)j * ldr + row] = x[j];\n}\n\n// Zero the strictly upper triangular part of the owned block columns.\n__global__ void zero_upper_kernel(double* __restrict__ panels, int n, int P, int rank) {\n    const int p = blockIdx.z;\n    const int jb = p * P + rank;\n    const int c = blockIdx.y;\n    if (c >= min(NB, n - jb * NB)) return;\n    const int diag = jb * NB + c;\n    const int row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (row < diag) panels[(size_t)p * n * NB + (size_t)c * n + row] = 0.0;\n}\n\n// A[j][j] += n for owned columns.\n__global__ void add_diag_kernel(double* __restrict__ panels, int n, int P, int rank,\n                                int count) {\n    const int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= count * NB) return;\n    const int p = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n    const int jb = p * P + rank;\n    if (c >= min(NB, n - jb * NB)) return;\n    panels[(size_t)p * n * NB + (size_t)c * n + jb * NB + c] += (double)n;\n}\n\n// Max absolute / relative error between reconstructed and original panels.\n__global__ void error_kernel(const double* __restrict__ recon,\n                             const double* __restrict__ orig, int n, int P, int rank,\n                             int count, double* __restrict__ outAbs,\n                             double* __restrict__ outRel) {\n    __shared__ double sAbs[256], sRel[256];\n    double mAbs = 0.0, mRel = 0.0;\n    const size_t total = (size_t)count * NB * n;\n    for (size_t idx = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; idx < total;\n         idx += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const int p = (int)(idx / ((size_t)NB * n));\n        const size_t rem = idx - (size_t)p * NB * n;\n        const int c = (int)(rem / n);\n        const int jb = p * P + rank;\n        if (c >= min(NB, n - jb * NB)) continue;\n        const double o = orig[idx];\n        const double error = fabs(recon[idx] - o);\n        mAbs = fmax(mAbs, error);\n        mRel = fmax(mRel, error / (fabs(o) + 1e-10));\n    }\n    sAbs[threadIdx.x] = mAbs;\n    sRel[threadIdx.x] = mRel;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if ((int)threadIdx.x < s) {\n            sAbs[threadIdx.x] = fmax(sAbs[threadIdx.x], sAbs[threadIdx.x + s]);\n            sRel[threadIdx.x] = fmax(sRel[threadIdx.x], sRel[threadIdx.x + s]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        outAbs[blockIdx.x] = sAbs[0];\n        outRel[blockIdx.x] = sRel[0];\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ninline int ceilDiv(long a, long b) { return (int)((a + b - 1) / b); }\n\nvoid launchGemmNT(const double* A, int lda, const double* B, int ldb, double* C, int ldc,\n                  int M, int N, int K, double alpha, bool accumulate) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid(ceilDiv(N, TN), ceilDiv(M, TM));\n    gemm_nt_kernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS>>>(A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, M, N, K, alpha,\n                                           accumulate ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\n// Distributed lower triangular matrix: block column jb (width <= NB) lives on\n// rank jb % P at local index jb / P; each local panel is n x NB column-major.\nstruct DistMatrix {\n    int n = 0, P = 1, rank = 0, nblk = 0, count = 0;\n    double* d_panels = nullptr;\n\n    int width(int jb) const { return std::min(NB, n - jb * NB); }\n    int owner(int jb) const { return jb % P; }\n    int local(int jb) const { return jb / P; }\n    int global(int p) const { return p * P + rank; }\n    double* panel(int p) const { return d_panels + (size_t)p * n * NB; }\n    size_t localElems() const { return (size_t)count * n * NB; }\n    // first local index with global block > k (or count if none)\n    int firstAfter(int k) const {\n        if (rank > k) return 0;\n        return (k - rank) / P + 1;\n    }\n};\n\n// Factor the panel of global block column k (owned by this rank) in place:\n// L11 = chol(A11), L21 = A21 * L11^{-T}.  Right-looking with inner block IB.\nvoid factorPanel(const DistMatrix& dm, int k, int* d_flag) {\n    const int n = dm.n;\n    const int w = dm.width(k);\n    double* base = dm.panel(dm.local(k)) + (size_t)k * NB;  // row k*NB, col 0\n    const int rows = n - k * NB;\n    for (int jj = 0; jj < w; jj += IB) {\n        const int iw = std::min(IB, w - jj);\n        double* tile = base + (size_t)jj * n + jj;\n        potf2_kernel<<<1, 32>>>(tile, n, iw, k * NB + jj, d_flag);\n        const int Mrows = rows - jj - iw;\n        if (Mrows > 0) {\n            trsm_rnt_kernel<<<ceilDiv(Mrows, 128), 128>>>(tile, n, tile + iw, n, Mrows, iw);\n            const int Ncols = w - jj - iw;\n            if (Ncols > 0) {\n                launchGemmNT(tile + iw, n, tile + iw, n,\n only) on the GPU.\n// B is generated exactly as in the sequential program.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(const DistMatrix& dm) {\n    const size_t n = (size_t)dm.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    // Column-major copy of B (== transpose of the row-major array)\n    std::vector<double> Bcm(n * n);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t jb = 0; jb < n; jb += 64) {\n        for (size_t ib = 0; ib < n; ib += 64) {\n            const size_t ie = std::min(n, ib + 64), je = std::min(n, jb + 64);\n            for (size_t i = ib; i < ie; ++i)\n                for (size_t j = jb; j < je; ++j) Bcm[j * n + i] = B[i * n + j];\n        }\n    }\n    B.clear();\n    B.shrink_to_fit();\n\n    if (dm.count == 0) return;\n\n    double* d_B = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_B, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_B, Bcm.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    for (int p = 0; p < dm.count; ++p) {\n        const int jb = dm.global(p);\n        // A(:, cols of jb) = B * B(rows of jb, :)^T\n        launchGemmNT(d_B, dm.n, d_B + (size_t)jb * NB, dm.n, dm.panel(p), dm.n, dm.n,\n                     dm.width(jb), dm.n, 1.0, false);\n    }\n    add_diag_kernel<<<ceilDiv((long)dm.count * NB, 256), 256>>>(dm.d_panels, dm.n, dm.P,\n                                                               dm.rank, dm.count);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_B));\n}\n\n// Distributed right-looking Cholesky with one-step lookahead.\n// Returns true on success; on failure *badIndex holds the offending diagonal.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(const DistMatrix& dm, size_t* badIndex) {\n    const int n = dm.n, P = dm.P, rank = dm.rank, nblk = dm.nblk;\n    if (nblk == 0) return true;\n\n    int* d_flag = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_flag, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_flag, 0x7f, sizeof(int)));\n\n    const size_t panelElems = (size_t)n * NB;\n    double* h_buf[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    double* d_buf[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_buf[b], panelElems * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_buf[b], panelElems * sizeof(double)));\n    }\n\n    auto packPanel = [&](int k) {\n        // Owner: factor panel k and pack rows [k*NB, n) into h_buf[k % 2].\n        factorPanel(dm, k, d_flag);\n        int flag = INT_MAX;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&flag, d_flag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        const int rows = n - k * NB;\n        const double* src = dm.panel(dm.local(k)) + (size_t)k * NB;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_buf[k % 2], (size_t)rows * sizeof(double), src,\n                                (size_t)n * sizeof(double), (size_t)rows * sizeof(double),\n                                dm.width(k), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        return flag;\n    };\n\n    auto finish = [&](bool ok) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_buf[b]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_buf[b]));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_flag));\n        return ok;\n    };\n\n    auto checkError = [&](int localFlag) {\n        int globalFlag = INT_MAX;\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localFlag, &globalFlag, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        if (globalFlag != INT_MAX) {\n            *badIndex = (size_t)globalFlag;\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    // Prologue: panel 0\n    {\n        int flag = INT_MAX;\n        if (dm.owner(0) == rank) flag = packPanel(0);\n        if (checkError(flag)) return finish(false);\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(h_buf[0], n * dm.width(0), MPI_DOUBLE, dm.owner(0), MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    }\n\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    for (int k = 0; k < nblk; ++k) {\n        const int rowsK = n - k * NB;\n        const int wk = dm.width(k);\n        const int cur = k % 2;\n\n        if (k > 0) MPI_CHECK(MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE));\n\n        const int p1 = dm.firstAfter(k);  // first owned block column after k\n        if (p1 < dm.count) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_buf[cur], h_buf[cur], (size_t)rowsK * wk * sizeof(double),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            // Lookahead: update the next owned block column first ...\n            const int maxM = n - dm.global(p1) * NB;\n            dim3 grid(ceilDiv(NB, TN), ceilDiv(maxM, TM), 1);\n            trailing_update_kernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS>>>(dm.d_panels, d_buf[cur], n, P,\n                                                           rank, k, p1, rowsK, wk);\n        }\n\n        int flag = INT_MAX;\n        const bool hasNext = (k + 1 < nblk);\n        if (hasNext && dm.owner(k + 1) == rank) {\n            // ... and if it is panel k+1, factor it right away and start its broadcast.\n grid(ceilDiv(NB, TN), ceilDiv(maxM, TM), dm.count - pStart);\n            trailing_update_kernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS>>>(dm.d_panels, d_buf[cur], n, P,\n  return finish(false);\n        }\n    }\n    return finish(true);\n}\n\n// Gather all block columns to every rank (host memory, panels padded to NB).\nstd::vector<double> allgatherPanels(const DistMatrix& dm) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(dm.P), displs(dm.P);\n    for (int r = 0; r < dm.P; ++r) {\n        const int c = (dm.nblk > r) ? (dm.nblk - r + dm.P - 1) / dm.P : 0;\n        counts[r] = (int)((size_t)c * dm.n * NB);\n        displs[r] = (r == 0) ? 0 : displs[r - 1] + counts[r - 1];\n    }\n    std::vector<double> local(dm.localElems());\n    if (!local.empty())\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local.data(), dm.d_panels, local.size() * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    std::vector<double> all((size_t)dm.nblk * dm.n * NB);\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(local.data(), (int)local.size(), MPI_DOUBLE, all.data(),\n                             counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    return all;\n}\n\n// Pointer to the (gathered, host) block column jb.\nconst double* gatheredBlock(const DistMatrix& dm, const std::vector<double>& all, int jb) {\n    size_t off = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < dm.owner(jb); ++r) {\n        const int c = (dm.nblk > r) ? the maximum errors are reduced over all ranks.\n    const int n = dm.n;\n    double localAbs = 0.0, localRel = 0.0;\n    if (dm.count > 0 && n > 0) {\n        double* d_L = nullptr;\n        double* d_recon = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_L, (size_t)n * n * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_recon, dm.localElems() * sizeof(double)));\n        for (int jb = 0; Then\n// every thread solves one row of R.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(PANEL_THREADS)\npotf2_trsm_kernel(double* __restrict__ T, int ldt, double* __restrict__ R, int ldr, int M,\n                  int tw, int gidx0, int* __restrict__ flag) {\n    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n    __shared__ double prodv[IB];\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < IB * IB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx / IB, c = idx % IB;\n        s[r][c] = (r < tw && c <= r) ? T[(size_t)c * ldt + r] : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (!potf2_shared(s, prodv, tw)) {\n        if (blockIdx.x == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            int j = 0;\n            while (j < tw && s[j][j] > 0.0) ++j;\n            atomicMin(flag, gidx0 + j);\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    if (blockIdx.x == 0) {\n        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < IB * IB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n            const int r = idx / IB, c = idx % IB;\n            if (r < tw && c <= r) T[(size_t)c * ldt + r] = s[r][c];\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (row >= M) return;\n    double x[IB];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < IB; ++j) x[j] = (j < tw) ? c < MAX_CHUNKS; ++c) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evPack[c]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_flag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_flag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(cs));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(xs));\n        return ok;\n    };\n\n    auto checkError = [&](int localFlag) {\n        int globalFlag = NO_ERROR;\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localFlag, &globalFlag, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        if (globalFlag != NO_ERROR) {\n            *badIndex = (size_t)globalFlag;\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    // Post the broadcast of panel k (owner: as soon as each chunk is packed).\n    auto postBcast = [&](int k, bool isOwner, MPI_Request* req) {\n        const size_t rows = (size_t)rowsOf(k);\n        for (int c = 0; c < nChunks(k); ++c) {\n            if (isOwner) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evPack[c]));\n            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Ibcast(commBuf(k) + (size_t)c * CH * rows,\n                                 (int)(rows * chunkCols(k, c)), MPI_DOUBLE, dm.owner(k),\n                                 MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req[c]));\n        }\n    };\n    // Wait for the broadcast of panel k and upload it (copy stream).\n    auto receivePanel = [&](int k, MPI_Request* req) {\n        const size_t rows = (size_t)rowsOf(k);\n        if (!cudaAware) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(xs, evDone[k % 2], 0));\n        for (int c = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evDone[b], cs));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[b], xs));\n    }\n    MPI_Request req[MAX_CHUNKS];\n\n    // Prologue: panel 0\n    {\n        int flag = NO_ERROR;\n        const bool isOwner = (dm.owner(0) == rank);\n        if (isOwner) {\n            packPanel(0);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evPack[0]));\n            flag = *h_flag;\n        }\n        if (checkError(flag)) return finish(false);\n        postBcast(0, isOwner, req);\n        receivePanel(0, req);\n    }\n\n    for (int k = 0; Measured: 1 GPU ~435 GFLOPS at n=8192, 4 GPUs ~1540 GFLOPS at n=16384 and ~2100 GFLOPS at n=32768 (about 95% of aggregate FP64 peak). Output sums match the sequential original to all printed digits.\n\n**Why:** Two things that looked like wins regressed and should not be retried blindly: running the panel factorization on a second CUDA stream (even with stream priorities) made things slower because its small kernels starve behind the big trailing-update kernel; and a 32-warp or fused \"factor+solve\" tile kernel was 2-3x slower than the single-warp 32x32 tile kernel because of 1024-thread barriers and redundant work. Block width 256 beat 512 everywhere.\n\n**How to apply:** Keep the panel factorization serialized on the compute stream ahead of the trailing update; tune via env vars CHOLESKY_NB and CHOLESKY_CUDA_AWARE rather than code edits. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgNA2bPTU8SUb9kEa6X7m","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid parallelization is complete, built, and verified. Only the two existing files changed: `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `cholesky`.\n\n**How it is parallelized**\n\n- **MPI:** the matrix is distributed 1-D block-cyclically over 256-wide block columns, one GPU per rank (GPU chosen by node-local rank). Right-looking blocked Cholesky: the owner factors its panel, broadcasts it, and every rank applies the rank-256 update to its own block columns. A one-step lookahead factors panel k+1 and starts its non-blocking broadcast while the trailing update of step k runs. Packing, broadcast, and upload are pipelined in 64-column chunks on a separate copy stream. If MPI is CUDA-aware, device buffers are used directly. Otherwise pinned host staging is used, which is the default on this machine since its Open MPI reports no CUDA support.\n- **CUDA:** all floating-point work runs on the GPU with custom kernels and no library dependencies. A register-tiled 64x64 DGEMM/SYRK kernel does the trailing update in one batched launch per step, a single-warp kernel factors 32x32 diagonal tiles, and a row-per-thread kernel does the triangular solves. Matrix generation and validation are also done on the GPUs, split by column.\n- **OpenMP:** host transposes, assembly of the row-major result for printing, and the error reduction.\n\n**Semantics preserved:** same seed-42 random matrix, the same lower-triangular output with zeroed upper part, identical output format, the same validation tolerance, and the same error path for non-positive-definite input (verified on a throwaway copy with a flipped diagonal; it prints the error at element 0 and exits with code 1). Rank 0 does all printing. Sums and samples in the `-r` output match the original to all 17 printed digits at every size tested, and validation passes at every size and rank count tested, including ragged sizes (1000, 300), a single block (100), and more ranks than blocks.\n\n**Performance (measured here, RTX 3090s, original is 1.4 GFLOPS)**\n\n| Config | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|\n| 1 GPU, n=8192 | 434 |\n| 2 GPUs, n=8192 | 702 |\n| 4 GPUs, n=16384 | 1540 |\n| 4 GPUs, n=32768 | 2104 (about 95% of aggregate FP64 peak) |\n\n**Notes for use**\n\n- Build with `cmake` as before. The source file is compiled by nvcc through CMake's CUDA language support, with the GPU architecture defaulting to the build machine's.\n- Two optional environment variables exist for tuning on other clusters: `CHOLESKY_NB` for the panel width (default 256, which beat 512 in every test here) and `CHOLESKY_CUDA_AWARE=1` to force direct device-buffer MPI. Forcing it on this machine crashes because its MPI build lacks real CUDA support, so it stays off by default.\n- Scaling at small sizes such as n=8192 on 4 GPUs is limited by per-step broadcast latency. Larger problems scale well."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":698,"cache_read_input_tokens":127564,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":698},"output_tokens":703,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"dbbac4c5-097a-4671-879b-53a88f524742","uuid":"a5bb98de-a2ff-4f8c-80d5-670f3857546f","timestamp":"2026-10-25T02:20:59.798Z","request_id":"req_011CgNA2b8L7JArFJkTAKTKW"}
